description: System deployment manifest — per-page Cloudflare-Functions dependency + route/file ownership. Consumed by scripts/pages-exclude.mjs (GitHub Pages safety, set-equality enforced) and scripts/env-guard.mjs (staging isolation). Repo-only; changing this file changes NO live deployment until an owner merge to main.

platform.note: A page is Function-dependent when it calls /api/* (config, docs, notify, auth, OCR). GitHub Pages serves static files only — it has no /api/* runtime — so a Function-dependent page is broken there and MUST be redirected to canonical_origin. Function dependency is modeled PER PAGE below (not per system); some System-2 helper pages are pure static and are safe on GitHub Pages.

github_pages_exclude.policy: DERIVED — the exclusion set is exactly { page.file : page.needs_functions === true }. scripts/pages-exclude.mjs enforces this by set-equality: CI fails if any needs_functions page is not redirected, or if any redirected page is not needs_functions / missing on disk. Do not hand-maintain a second list.

isolation.note: Production ref is duplicated in scripts/env-guard.mjs and functions/api/portal-config.js as the deny target. Staging must be a SEPARATE Supabase project + R2 bucket, configured in Cloudflare Preview-scope variables. See audit-output/STAGING_SETUP_PLAN.md. Provisioning + isolation proof is owner external action (G1-05), not completed in-repo.
